CommonSourceCodeProject (fork)

This is a fork of Common Source Code Project by Toshiya Takeda.

It focuses on improving the eBASICMasterJr (bmjr) emulator for Hitach BASIC Master Jr. (MB-6885).

The original distribution and readme.txt are available here.

Original distribution: https://takeda-toshiya.my.coocan.jp/common/index.html
Original description: readme.txt
